links.statement: The privileged remediation workflow must verify a candidate source_ref without running any general auto-repair (mobile source sync, OpenAPI generation, dependency dedupe, lint --fix, go mod tidy, gofmt).
.gitignore must not silently drop new tracked documentation under docs/ or infra/ with no error from git or any guard.
Task scope-check tooling must not report false OUTSIDE_ALLOWED_PATHS / scope-expansion violations for unrelated commits landed on a shared work branch after a task's baseSha.

GitHub branch protection, required status checks, and separation of duties on master must be proven from GitHub's own settings (ruleset and branch protection API responses), not merely declared in a tracked JSON file.

recordedChangedPaths' self-declared execution.changedPaths must eventually be cross-checked against the real git diff for a task's own commit(s), not trusted unconditionally, to close the defense-in-depth gap GAP-0005's fix itself introduced.

Every product journey (JRN-001..JRN-042) with at least one registry-declared candidate surface must have a corresponding product_model_node in governance/remediation/capability-graph.json binding its owning domain, journey title, and registry decision status; JRN-043 and JRN-044 are known, explicitly-tracked exceptions (no backtick-quoted surface tokens resolved from their registry prose) pending a follow-up gap rather than a fabricated surface binding.
